entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 66714384142368256: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 17702: distance 123.609 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.052), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 123.609 +/- 6.428 pc; Gaia DR3 gives this source no parallax (a two-parameter solution). Proper motion: Gaia DR3 source 66714384142368256 is a two-parameter solution with no proper motion; zero is assumed (at 124 pc, 1 mas/yr would be 1 km/s across the sky). Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 66714384142368256 (quality B), from 2006AstL...32..759G; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 13.762 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 17702: radius 13.762 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 843.922 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.91) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 8392 +/- 4070 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 17702: effective temperature 8392 +/- 4070 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.113).

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: Kharitonov, Tereshchenko & Knyazeva (1988), Spectrophotometric Catalogue of Stars (Alma-Ata), record 222: HR 1165; VizieR III/202, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #aec4ff. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 23630 is not in the library; pulkovo: HR 1165 is not in the catalogue; kiehling: HR 1165 is not among its 60 stars; burnashev: BS 1165 is not in part2; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; kharitonov: used.
